docstring: Block Transformer with Hierarchical Intra-Block and Inter-Block Attention (HIBA).  Production-hardened implementation supporting: 1. Robust Pretrained Weight Extraction across DistilBERT, RoBERTa/BERT nested encoders,    GPT-2 (fused Conv1D), and Qwen/LLaMA/Mistral. 2. Nested Encoder Detection to prevent double output projection signal attenuation
